visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman in a white tank top and black shorts stands on a blue tennis court during the day. She practices swinging a blue racket, looking focused but slightly clumsy. (2) She speaks directly to the camera in a close-up, expressing concern. POV shots show her view across the net as a coach prepares to hit a ball. (3) She stands next to a male coach in a blue shirt who holds several tennis balls and gestures while explaining techniques. (4) A montage sequence follows where she practices volleying at the net. Several shots miss or hit the net, with comical text overlays highlighting the failures. (5) Transition to nighttime on the same court under bright stadium lights. She engages in a rally with an opponent, successfully hitting several volleys back and forth. (6) In the final scene, she jokes with the coach, holding her racket in front of her face in a defensive pose and laughing.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a series of percussive impacts of a tennis ball against a racket, punctuated by high-arousal female vocalizations. Mid-tempo acoustic guitar BGM provides a bright, rhythmic foundation. (2) The female speaker transitions to a conversational tone with high pitch variability, discussing her training frustrations. A sudden 'whoosh' SFX signals a scene shift. (3) A male voice enters with a calm, authoritative professional tone, offering coaching advice while background nature ambience remains subtle. (4) Multiple sharp impact sounds occur during a montage, accompanied by cartoonish 'pop' and 'boing' sound effects representing failed attempts. (5) The rhythm of the hits stabilizes during a long rally at night, with the BGM swelling slightly in volume. The woman's breathing becomes more audible and strained due to physical effort. (6) The final phase is dominated by friendly vocal banter and laughter from both speakers, ending with a series of digital UI chime SFX as they joke about a defensive strategy.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Setup -> Conflict -> Instruction -> Practice -> Resolution -> Humor
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video is a lifestyle vlog capturing a tennis training session. It follows the creator's journey from struggling with basic strokes to learning net volleying techniques from a coach. The video combines educational coaching moments with humorous practice failures and a successful night-time rally to entertain and inform followers.
